passage: Oakwood School is proud to launch our new Green Project this term. The main purpose is to help students learn about sustainable farming and where their food comes from. We are collaborating with Mr. Smith, an experienced farmer from nearby Green Valley Farm. Students can choose from a variety of activities, such as planting seeds, watering plants, or even helping with the harvest. One exciting feature is a webcam set up in the project garden, allowing anyone to watch the plants grow online. We plan to deliver the fresh produce we grow to the school canteen, so students can enjoy healthy meals. To approach this project effectively, we have organized workshops every Friday. Don't forget to visit the decorative fountain near the garden entrance – it's a perfect spot for thinking and planning. Join us in making a difference!
